# kmp-compose-ios-pilot

A small disposable Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform calculator app with a planted boundary defect: `discountCents` uses `> 10_000` where the contract says 10,000 cents or more. hStack uses it as the consumer fixture for KMP and CMP work when no real app is selected (see **Consumer fixture** in the [glossary](../../../docs/GLOSSARY.md)).

Copy the app elsewhere before a repair, so this baseline stays untouched. Apart from this README and `.gitattributes`, every file here is a byte-for-byte copy of `packs/mobile/tests/kmp-compose-ios-pilot` from hstack-alpha (retired predecessor) at revision `99cc6129aea3f702ee6cd3b448e4f67700b4353c`. hstack-alpha is a different project and its GitHub repository was deleted on 2026-10-16, so the `com.hstack.gatef4.pilot` package, bundle and scheme names in these files are its names, not this project's. Nothing from the original was left out, including `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar`. The repository checks were not changed to admit it. The `.gitattributes` file marks the CRLF line endings of `gradlew.bat` as intended, so the whitespace check still rejects trailing spaces there and everywhere else.
